brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.requirement: A closed electronics enclosure: a hex base with all its open faces closed by covers, no open sides.
requirements.evidence: Hex base (piece Full) with a Full cover on top and one on bottom, plus six edge caps (3 male, 3 female) at all six wall bearings. check_build reports no issues and meshClash clear. The enclosure is closed in the configurator's terms, but no electronics board is modelled, and I could not confirm the caps leave the louvre wall open.

requirements.requirement: A louvred vent (Port louvre) set into one wall so the board inside can breathe.
requirements.evidence: One hex-port-louvre port (port:0#0,0#0) sits on wall slot 0 of the base. Its wall also received an edge cap at one of the six bearings, and the configurator does not say which bearing is that wall, so the vent may be blocked by a cap. Also, the port-louvre description says it vents a closed cell without letting rain in; whether it actually moves air is not something this configurator can check.

finish.summary: Built a closed hex enclosure: one full base, top and bottom covers, six edge caps, and one Port louvre on a side wall. check_build is clean with meshClash clear. Two open points: the caps were placed on all six bearings, so the louvre wall may be capped over, and no board is modelled. I did not confirm the vent is open to air.
